title: A Big Day at School
text: Today is a big day. I feel excited about the school trip. But I am also a little nervous. My friend is scared of bugs. At lunch, I am very hungry, and I eat a big sandwich. In art class, I feel bored, so I draw a funny picture. My teacher is surprised and happy to see it. At the end of the day, I am tired but very happy!

questions.question: How does the writer feel about the school trip?
questions.source_sentence: I feel excited about the school trip.

questions.question: What is the friend scared of?
questions.source_sentence: My friend is scared of bugs.

questions.question: How does the writer feel at the end of the day?
questions.source_sentence: At the end of the day, I am tired but very happy!
